records.text: Buckley Air Force Base operated under that name from 2000 through 2021 near Aurora, Colorado.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It was the Buckley Air Force Base from the year 2000 to 2021. So there's a military presence here.

verification.notes: Official Space Force histories state that Buckley Air Force Base was activated under that name on October 1, 2000, and was renamed Buckley Space Force Base on June 4, 2021; it is in Aurora, Colorado.
